notes.title: Bird Game - Update 2
notes.notes:
[list]
    [*]Added achievements for defeating bosses
    [*]Enemy/boss tracking is smoother and harder to cheese
    [*]Fixed fullscreen switch with alt+enter not saving on reload
    [*]Massively decreased used disk space on Windows
[/list]

If you find any bugs or issues, please contact at kitchenoven@gmail.com and I will try to fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: Bird Game - Update 1
notes.notes:
[list]
    [*]Removed some unnecessary fluff from final boss
    [*]Tweaks to places in levels where people tend to get stuck
    [*]Fixed camera judder when respawning or transitioning to a new level
    [*]Beetle hitboxes are disabled after getting hit by them (shouldn't get stuck in them anymore)
    [*]Fixed some sound issues
[/list]

If you find any bugs or issues, please contact at kitchenoven@gmail.com and I will try to fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: Controller Hotfix
notes.notes:
First update! Thank you to everyone who has given Bird Game a shot. There were some issues with controller mapping that people found, but this patch should fix them.

[list]
    [*]Fixed issue with some buttons being labeled incorrectly
    [*]Added controller config menu under control settings (entered automatically if you start with a controller plugged in)
    [*]Probably broke something
[/list]

Next I will be working on fixing minor graphical errors, balance, and adding more achievements.

If you find any bugs or issues, please contact at kitchenoven@gmail.com and I will try to fix them as soon as possible.
